title: Beca Universidad de Chile (BUCH)
official_source: Universidad de Chile - Direccion de Bienestar y Desarrollo Estudiantil (DIRBDE)
program_type: University merit and socioeconomic need scholarship
duration: Full official duration of the chosen programme (renEWed annually)
description: The Beca Universidad de Chile (BUCH) is a tuition benefit awarded to 100 young people of academic excellence, financing the full value of the enrolment fee and the tuition of any undergraduate career or programme of the Universidad de Chile. Its objective is to recognise and reward the excellent academic performance and economic support needs of the country's young talents.

title: Programa de Becas de Cooperacion Sur-Sur - Republica de Chile 2027 (AGCID)
official_source: Agencia Chilena de Cooperacion Internacional para el Desarrollo (AGCID), Government of Chile
duration: Up to 24 months (maximum four academic semesters or six quarters), aligned to the official duration of the chosen master's programme

title: Overseas Scholarship for MS/M.Phil and Ph.D Studies (Phase-III), Higher Education Commission Pakistan
duration: Maintenance allowance payable for up to 24 months for the MS program and up to 48 months for the PhD program; tuition contribution capped at two years for MS and four years for PhD.
description: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan awards MS/M.Phil and PhD scholarships to Pakistani and Azad Jammu and Kashmir nationals to study at universities ranked in the top 200 of the QS or THE world rankings, in eight named thematic areas. Payments cover a maintenance allowance, a capped contribution to tuition fees, health insurance and one economy-class round-trip air ticket. Admission to the foreign university is separate from the award and must be secured by the scholar. title: IUJ Nakayama Premium Scholarship
duration: Master's programmes at IUJ run one academic year (GSIM MBA / Digital Transformation) or two academic years (GSIM two-year MBA, GSIR International Development and Public Management); the PhD route is a separate programme with its own application rounds
description: The Nakayama Premium is an IUJ scholarship for non-Japanese applicants listed under IUJ's Scholarship Guidelines, covering 100% of tuition, a partial admissions fee and a JPY 100,000 monthly stipend. It is awarded competitively at the time of admission to Master's and PhD students who apply as non-sponsored applicants.

title: Asian University for Women Scholarships and Financial Aid (full and partial need-based aid)
program_type: University need-based scholarship and financial aid
duration: Financial aid is assessed before the start of each academic programme and continued year by year; students must maintain a CGPA of 2.5 each year to retain it.
description: AUW strives to meet the demonstrated financial need of each admitted student and offers full and partial scholarships based on each student's financial circumstances, with full scholarships covering tuition, room and board, course supplies, student activities and primary healthcare. Financial aid is awarded by AUW itself as part of the admission application and assessed by the Financial Aid Committee on family circumstances.

title: Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship (KDI School of Public Policy and Management)
official_source: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, Korea Development Institute
description: Full-tuition-waiver plus monthly stipend plus round-trip airfare award administered by KDI School, the graduate school of the Korea Development Institute, in Sejong. It is intended for working professionals in the public sector and other potential global leaders, and decisions are made by the school's Admissions Committee. There is no separate scholarship application: candidates are considered through the ordinary KDI School online admissions application.

title: ACIAR Pacific Agriculture Scholarships and Support Program (PASS)
official_source: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR)
duration: Up to 2 years for Master's students; 3 years (or over, if applicable) for PhD candidates
description: The Pacific Agriculture Scholarships and Support (PASS) Program funds postgraduate research scholarships in agriculture, forestry and fisheries at the University of the South Pacific (USP) and Fiji National University (FNU). It is an Australian Government programme delivered by ACIAR, an Australian Government statutory authority, and is described by ACIAR as part of the Australian Government's support to Pacific neighbours.
